servinfo.title: Vehicle swaying warning function does not work normally

attention3.ptxt: Dual sensor brake support system is controlled by dual sensor brake support control module communicating with the following control modules through CAN communication. Before performing symptom diagnosis, check that no DTC is indicated in these control modules.

condition.ptxt: Vehicle swaying warning function does not work normally

ps.ptxt: Vehicle swaying warning function is not in execution state

action.ptxt: Unload the vehicle, remove modification parts for vehicle’s height, wiper blade(s), windshield, etc. and replace with genuine parts.

ps.ptxt: Road configuration is difficult to recognize by dual sensor brake support control module
